definitions.gloss: feeding animals; giving food to animals or fish
definitions.explanation: The act of feeding animals, whether pets, livestock, or wild animals. Often seen on signs prohibiting feeding.

examples.japanese: {餌|えさ}やりは{禁止|きんし}です。
{毎朝|まいあさ}{金魚|きんぎょ}の{餌|えさ}やりをする。
examples.english: I feed the goldfish every morning.

examples.japanese: {動物園|どうぶつえん}では{来場者|らいじょうしゃ}が{参加|さんか}できる{餌|えさ}やり{体験|たいけん}が{人気|にんき}だ。
examples.english: At the zoo, the feeding experience that visitors can participate in is popular.

notes:
A compound of {餌|えさ} (feed; bait) and やり (giving). Very commonly seen on signs in parks, zoos, and public areas where feeding wild animals is restricted.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {餌|えさ}やり{禁止|きんし}: no feeding (sign)
- {餌|えさ}やりをする: to feed (animals)
- {餌|えさ}やりの{時間|じかん}: feeding time
- {餌|えさ}やり{体験|たいけん}: feeding experience (at a zoo or farm)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {給餌|きゅうじ}: feeding — formal/technical term used in agriculture and animal husbandry
- {餌付|えづ}け: taming animals with food; habituating wild animals to being fed — often has a negative connotation when done to wild animals

USAGE:
The phrase {餌|えさ}やり{禁止|きんし} (no feeding) is one of the most common signs in Japanese parks and tourist areas, especially around deer, pigeons, and stray cats.
